decisions.mark: names mbedtls_strerror as the entry point and locates it in library/error.c
explains that a code carries TWO layers — a high-level module part and a low-level part — and that mbedtls_strerror renders both, joined, when both are present
concludes that library/error.c is GENERATED from the public headers by scripts/generate_errors.pl using scripts/data_files/error.fmt as its template
concludes that adding a new error string means adding the /** */-documented #define to the module's public header and re-running the generator, NOT editing library/error.c
states that MBEDTLS_ERROR_C is ENABLED in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so the string table is present in a default build
identifies MBEDTLS_ERROR_STRERROR_DUMMY as a separate switch that keeps mbedtls_strerror LINKABLE while the string table is compiled out, and states that it too is enabled by default
